name: Open Outcry
tagline: Pump the ticker, buy the dip, cash out before the correction.
core_loop: On your turn play a card to a suit's ticker to move its price, buy a card into your portfolio as a share, or sell a share by swapping it for the ticker's top card; a die corrects one stock each round.
win_condition: Highest total of banked vault cards plus the final price of every share you hold.
